metadata.title: आदिवासी का सब कुछ डूब गया, पानी फिर भी नहीं मिला | Why tribals are not getting Narmada water
metadata.description: Lakhs of hectares of tribal land in Mandla district has been submerged in the water of the Bargi dam built on the Narmada river. But the fields of tribal farmers have not yet received water. Tribal farmers demand that the government provide water to their fields through a lift irrigation project. The tribals of this area in the leadership of their MLA Dr Ashok Marskole marched for 3 days to press for this demand and reached district headquarters and submitted their demand to the commissioner.
